anomalies.observed: The MAX3485 (U2) pins 6 (A) and 7 (B) are wired directly together and to the shared serial bus net NET0022.
anomalies.expected: The MAX3485 A and B pins should be separate differential lines, with the specified bias/pull network (R6, R7, R8, R15) applied individually as described in the design specification.

evidence.quote: U2 MAX3485 pins 6 (A) and 7 (B) are connected by a wire to the same node labeled NET0022.
R6, R7, R8, R15 | 2k, 20k, 2.2k, 2.2k | Bias/pull network on the MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line.

anomalies.impact: Shorting A and B forces the differential receiver input to 0 V and shorts the transceiver's complementary driver outputs. The serial servo mode will not receive data correctly, and the MAX3485 may be damaged when transmitting.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a serious wiring error: the MAX3485 A and B differential pins are shorted together on the shared serial bus, which will prevent proper half-duplex serial servo communication and may damage the transceiver.
